whyCareReason: Formula1.com's table ahead of the 9-11 October sprint weekend still has Antonelli 84 points clear. A printed Norris win does not match that table.
teaser: Race listed for Sunday 11 October, 8:00 p.m. local. Verstappen won the previous race, at Sepang, on 4 October.
story: Singapore has not been run. AFP on 7 October published the drivers' standings ahead of the Singapore Grand Prix and sprint. Formula1.com prints the same top six: Antonelli 320, Russell 236, Hamilton 214, Leclerc 191, Norris 188, Verstappen 188. Mercedes 556, Ferrari 405 and McLaren 316 follow from those pairs. The race start listed for Marina Bay is Sunday 11 October at 8:00 p.m. local time.
stakes: Seven rounds were still listed after Sepang on one calendar. Singapore is the next one. Austin is not this weekend.
rivalryAngle: Russell won Baku. Verstappen won at Sepang. Neither result is a Singapore classification.
